openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Friday, the day of Venus. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Finish the week sharp. Attract the win; don't chase it.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go win Friday.

mindset.hed: Close the Week Like a Contender
mindset.body: The Bucs just won a game without completing a single pass — rain, resolve, and the run game. Ben Johnson called it potent. Friday is your finish line before the weekend: one clean block that makes the rest of the week look intentional. Attract the outcome by doing the hard rep first. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Friday, the day of Venus: run this right after Morning Charge. Cold and dry (~45°), so the RipStick finisher is fair game outside if you want the cold air. Strong, smooth reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.body: U.S. Pro, Max, and Ultra users can link bank and card accounts read-only through Plaid and ask Claude about spending and bills. It can't move or invest money.

items.hed: METR: Anthropic progressing about twice as fast
items.body: An independent Nov 5 assessment says Anthropic's capability progress roughly doubled vs an earlier period, with AI tools speeding up coding and experiment analysis. Much of the underlying evidence was redacted.
Stephen Curry scored 29 as Golden State improved to 6-3. Miami dropped to 3-6.
Devin Booker dropped 30 and Mikal Bridges grabbed 13 boards as Phoenix evened some early-season pressure. Orlando sits at 2-6.
Only two games Thursday after Victor Wembanyama's 52-and-24 stunner Wednesday. Weekend slate picks back up.

items.hed: No. 1 and No. 2 rushing attacks collide Sunday
items.body: Bucs average 168.6 rush yards; Bears 150.8. Ben Johnson called Tampa's line and scheme 'really good' ahead of Sunday Night Football.

items.hed: Wirfs, Diaby highlight Bucs injury report
items.body: Tristan Wirfs (toe) and Yaya Diaby (knee) did not practice Thursday. Bucky Irving and Chris Godwin took veteran rest days.

items.hed: Bears get Benedet and Jarrett back to limited
items.body: Both were DNP Wednesday and limited Thursday. Monangai still out; D'Marco Jackson (ankle) missed practice.

items.hed: Fight Night tomorrow: Cortes Acosta vs Walker
items.body: Short-notice heavyweight main event at Meta APEX. Prelims 5pm ET / main card 8pm ET on Paramount+. Co-main: Tatiana Suarez vs Virna Jandiroba.
Official weigh-ins for Cortes Acosta vs Walker begin around noon ET. Card also features Davey Grant vs Elijah Smith and more.

Friday belongs to Venus, Aphrodite to the Greeks: beauty, desire, harmony, and the power of attraction. Old magicians chose it for love, art, and drawing things toward you. Make the day magnetic — create something worth wanting.
Hermes Trismegistus wrote: 'That which is below is like that which is above.' The outer week mirrors the inner one. Clean one mess in your mind and watch the desk clear with it.
The 12th-century mystic heard the universe as music — viriditas, the greening force that makes life grow. Feed one living thing today: a project, a habit, or yourself.
